title: Collect slow resilience variables
goal: Implement a source-bound snapshot collector for slow deterioration without creating a synthetic truth store or automatic task authority.

approval.note: User explicitly authorized full registration and implementation on 2026-07-18; live-state, claims, diff review, CI, merge and runtime evidence remain mandatory.

acceptance.assertion: The first snapshot contains attention age, terminal-projection lag, recurring failure signatures, recovery-proof age, temporary-resource growth and closure duration.
Every value names authority, observation time, coverage and uncertainty.
Snapshots can be appended to Chronik idempotently and rendered without changing source truth.
No opaque global health score or automatic task creation is introduced.

does_not_establish: hostile same-user parent-directory substitution resistance before the promoted follow-up
a global health score or automatic task authority
future snapshot usefulness without accumulated longitudinal source data
authority outside the listed source systems
metadata.outcome: Ein source-bound Collector für sechs langsame Resilienzvariablen ist in Infra gemergt. Er bewahrt Quellenautorität, Beobachtungszeit, Abdeckung und Unsicherheit, rendert ohne Wahrheitsmutation und kann Chronik lokal idempotent über eine begrenzte JSONL-Outbox beliefern, ohne globalen Score oder automatische Task-Autorität.

validated_acceptance.bounded-metrics: PASS: Attention-Alter, Terminalprojektions-Lag, wiederkehrende Fehlersignaturen, Recovery-Proof-Alter, Wachstum temporärer Ressourcen und Abschlussdauer sind fest begrenzt implementiert und getestet.
validated_acceptance.source-binding: PASS: Jeder Metrikdatensatz enthält authority, observed_at, coverage und uncertainty; fehlende oder ungültige Evidenz bleibt partial oder unverified statt interpoliert zu werden.
validated_acceptance.historical-axis: PASS: Deterministische Snapshot-/Event-IDs, reine Darstellung und eine lokale, gesperrte, kollisionsprüfende und idempotente Chronik-JSONL-Outbox sind implementiert.
validated_acceptance.no-score: PASS: Schema, Renderer und Tests schließen einen globalen Gesundheitswert sowie automatische Task-Erzeugung ausdrücklich aus.

bureau_runtime_identity.purpose: historical diagnosis readback establishing that the immutable runtime and then-current canonical registry had converged at source commit 2a534cf

runtime compatibility after subsequent Bureau main commits

remaining_followups.scope: directory-FD-bound path hardening for hostile same-user parent-directory substitution
The observed closeout blocker resolved to a stale clean local checkout after runtime and origin/main had already converged; no runtime-identity guard was bypassed.
